question: Who is the creator of WWW or the world wide web?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tim Berners-Lee**__.

__
 
• The** creator** of **WWW** or the **world wide web** is **Tim Berners-Lee**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The World Wide Web, commonly known as the Web.
 
• It is an information system where documents and other web resources are identified by Uniform Resource Locators.
 
• Which may be interlinked by hyperlinks, and are accessible over the Internet. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Henry Edward Roberts** invented the** first commercially successful personal computer** in** 1974**.

 
 
• He is most often known as **"the father of the personal computer."**
 
 
 
• **Lawrence Edward Page** is an American computer scientist and Internet entrepreneur.
 
 
• He is best known as one of the **co-founders of Google along with Sergey Brin.**** **
 
 
 
• **Jeffrey Preston Bezos (Jeff Bezos)** is an American business magnate, media proprietor, and investor.
 
 
• Bezos is the founder and** CEO** of the multi-national technology company **Amazon.**
